_staff_group: Who may sign in. A VRChat group ID (grp_...), its short code, or part of its name. Empty means nobody.
_vrc_contact: Real email or Discord handle. VRChat's API returns 403 without it.
_sync_token: Shared secret desktop clients send on /api/sync/*. Generate with `python run_web.py --init`. Empty disables the sync API.
_note_filter: Word written into a player's VRChat note when you mark them In Range. Match the desktop app's setting.
_media_roots: Extra folders the server may serve clips/screenshots from. incident_shots/ is always allowed. Add your Medal folder to play clips in the browser.
_https_only: Set true when behind a TLS proxy so the session cookie is marked Secure.
